title: Cinders of Chaos area plan, version 1
description: A semantic plan of one generated area (docs/MAP_GUIDE.md "Area planner"). It names a biome, zones, paths, connections, spawns and the rest; it never holds an item id. server/tools/area_planner.py validates it, compiles it with our area generator into an OTBM piece and a spawn file, and renders it. Local coordinates are tiles from the area's top-left corner (0-based); floor 1 is the top floor, each next floor one level deeper.

id.description: file and area id, lower case

biome.description: one of the biomes of `area_planner.py catalogue` (swamp, marsh, crypt, lava, forest, ice, cave, waste, vault, catacomb, catacomb_earth, hall, abyss, sanctum; forest_pack and ice_pack need the pack items)

level.description: the hunting level band, lowest and highest

seed.description: the same seed gives the same tiles (default: from the id)

repair_reach.description: join walkable pockets cut off from the main region to it by the shortest carved link instead of closing them with rock (O738, server/README.md "Area planner candidates and reach repair (O738)"); default false, so a held plan keeps its tiles

water.description: rivers, lakes, sand beach shores, bridges and fords (O739, server/README.md "Rivers, lakes, bridges and fords (O739)"); absent: no water, a held plan keeps its tiles. Every land piece the water cuts off gets a crossing (a river's first one a bridge), so the area stays reachable; no spawn, chest, NPC or decoration on a crossing or next to it

rivers.description: bands of deep water that wander from one edge of the floor to the other

width.description: tiles across, lowest and highest (default areagen_config.lua water.river.width)

at.description: its line, in percent across the floor (default a seeded 35-65)

lakes.description: irregular blobs of deep water in a zone

place.description: a quarter of the zone off its centre (default a seeded diagonal; the centre itself stays dry)

fords.description: shallow walkable crossings wanted besides the bridges (default 0)

style.description: O743: the key of a style profile in tools/areaplan/styles/ (area_style_learn.py): ground, wall and decoration choices, decoration density and clusters come from it instead of the biome defaults (server/README.md "Style profile (O743)"); default none

ruin.description: O740: the share (percent) of a walled building's wall tiles that break into gaps and of half its free floor that loses the floor (server/README.md "Buildings phase 2 (O740)"); default 0; a building with floors above stays whole; nothing it does blocks a way

plateaus.description: raised walkable regions one floor up over a zone of floor 1, a second tier for height 2, edged by the biome's cliff (mountain ground and its gravel edge pieces), each with 1-2 ramps of our stair brush cut into a south facing edge (O744, server/README.md "Plateaus and cliffs (O744)"); absent or count 0: none, a held plan keeps its tiles. A plateau keeps off routes, buildings, crossings and water; spawns and chests may stand on top

size.description: tiles a side of the lower footprint, lowest and highest (default 12, 16); height 2 needs 17 or more

height.description: floors up: 1 (z - 1) or 2 (a second tier at z - 2), or [lowest, highest] picked by the seed (default 1)

ramps.description: ways up per tier, or [fewest, most] (default [1, 2]); the fewest must fit

zones.description: the zones they go in, in turn (default every hunt zone of floor 1 that is no boss room, camp or protection zone, the largest first)

origin.description: where the top-left tile of floor 1 goes on the map (default 14800, 14800 and the biome's depth); x/y 14336-15359 (the first content block) or x 15616-17663, y 14336-15359 (the hall-fill block east of it, docs/MAP_GUIDE.md "Content plans"), or y 15400-16383 (the annex row below both, server/README.md "Hunt annexes")

decoration.description: decoration density: the biome kit's rates x0.55, x1, x1.5 (docs/MAP_GUIDE.md "Area planner")

light.description: light sources (x0.5, x0.75, x1, x1.5 of the biome's)

shape.description: room: a rectangle; lobes: an asymmetric outline of overlapping lobes (the default outside dungeons); cave: the old chain of round blobs; arena: a round open room (default: room in a dungeon biome, lobes elsewhere)

size.description: small (7x7), medium (11x9), large (15x12), huge (20x16), or [w, h] in tiles (5-40)

at.description: top-left tile, local; leave out to let the planner place it

place.description: rough position on its floor when `at` is not given

role.description: boss = the boss room (one entrance); camp = a resting place, usually pz

pz.description: a protection zone (no spawn may stand in it)

ragged.description: ragged sides: each side of the zone bites in by a depth that wanders 0-4 tiles, so big rooms and caves lose their straight edges

style.description: corridor: straight runs; tunnel: winding; wild: winding with ragged sides, its width swells and narrows (default by biome)

type.description: stairs: our stair brush (stairs ground above, stone stairs below; a hole and ladder when there is no room); ladder: a hole down and a ladder up; hole: one way down; teleport: any two zones

two_way.description: teleport only: a return teleport too (default true)

from_world.description: the world map tile of the portal that leads in (recorded only; the world map is not edited)

to.description: where the exit portal sends players (else the area exit action id)

zone.description: the zone the spawn stands in (give zone or path)

path.description: [from, to] of a plan path: the spawn stands along that path, outside the zones (give zone or path)

monster.description: a monster name of our list (`area_planner.py catalogue --monsters`)

spread.description: even coverage: points about sqrt(free tiles / points) apart, closer only when they do not fit; default: random points 4 tiles apart

title.description: a display name for the review sheets

new.description: an NPC not in our list yet: the compile writes its XML and script stub

lines.description: a new NPC's greeting (first line) and answers

buildings.description: parametric buildings (server/tools/areaplan/prefabs, server/README.md "Buildings in the planner (O515)"): each stands inside one zone, stamped with walls, a door on the chosen side, a floor, features, decor and a roof one floor up; the plan never names an item id

kind.description: the prefab: areaplan/prefabs/<kind>.json; camp is an open kind (O740): no walls, no door, no roof

zone.description: the zone it stands in (its floor is the zone's)

at.description: top-left tile of the footprint, local like a zone's `at`; leave out for "auto inside the zone" (the buildings of a zone stand round its middle)

door.description: the side of the door; route = the side that faces the nearest route (default: the prefab's)

size.description: [width across the door wall, height from the back wall to the door wall], walls included; a door on the east or west side turns the building, so the footprint on the map is [height, width] (default: from the prefab's ranges, by the seed)

wall.description: a wall brush of areagen_config.lua / areaplan_build.lua (default: the prefab's)

floor.description: a walkable ground family of those tables (default: the prefab's)

roof.description: a roof on the floor above (default: the prefab's)

pz.description: a protection zone inside (default: the prefab's)

npc.description: the NPC of the prefab's npc slot (a priest, a keeper, a clerk); the existing NPC stub mechanism

new.description: an NPC not in our list yet: the compile writes its XML and script stub

slots.description: more decor slots beside the prefab's (family names of building_families.json)

dx.description: interior column from the west (negative: from the east end, "c": the door column)

dy.description: interior row from the back wall (negative: from the door wall)

facing.description: floor pieces that have a front: the side it faces in the canonical frame (door south)

floors_above.description: O740: floors above the building at z - 1 and z - 2, joined by stairs, the roof on the top one (default 0); a walled kind on floor 1 only

cellar.description: O740: a small dungeon one floor down, built by the area generator, reached by a large hole inside and a ladder back up (true, or {biome, size}); the floor under the building must be free

ruin.description: O740: this building's ruin share (default the plan's `ruin`)

quest.description: a quest key; the compile lists the chest's tile under it for the quest script

reward.description: what the chest gives once per character: item names from our item tables (never ids), gold and experience

chest_action.description: the action id of this area's quest chests (block 47960-47999; default: one from the block by the id)
